title: Trump declares robot imports a national security threat
hook_text: Robot imports now a national security threat
script:
President Donald Trump declared foreign-made industrial robots a national security threat on October twenty-eighth.
The executive order focuses on the rising reliance on foreign automation in American factories.
His administration initiated formal trade talks to assess risks from these overseas robotic systems.
The White House has set a one hundred eighty day deadline for these negotiations to conclude.
Officials are weighing potential new tariffs if these discussions fail to produce significant trade concessions.
This move directly impacts global suppliers like Fanuc and ABB who dominate current domestic robotics imports.
Would you support higher prices on consumer goods to keep robot manufacturing domestic?
